===Glyph origin===
{{liushu|p}} – a pig with penis, meaning "male pig". Shuowen considered this character "pig with foot" (从彑，下象其足), which is incorrect.

See also {{zh-l|家}}. Compare [[豖]], in which the male pig is castrated since the penis is detached from his body.
